name: mc_repair
title: Targeted build repairs
description:
Repairs only mismatching frozen eligible cells from a fresh mc_verify comparison, then checks the whole expectation again and returns the remaining differences and a new comparisonId. Never replays the complete original building request.

WHEN TO USE: after mc_verify check identified differences; review their positions before repairing. Use positions to select explicit mismatches, otherwise all are selected. WHEN NOT TO USE: broad rebuilds, flowing-fluid plans, arbitrary NBT/inventory restoration or concurrent transactional editing. Matching cells are never written. No connection pass, neighbor refresh or fluid physics runs.

PARAMETERS: required planId and comparisonId from the latest check. Optional positions are unique absolute [x,y,z] mismatches. maxChanges 1-10000 (default 1000) rejects oversized selections rather than silently taking a prefix. snapshot defaults true, covering the selected delta envelope and subject to current snapshot limits; false explicitly disables it. allowBlockEntityReplacement defaults false and protects deletion/material replacement of existing signs/chests/etc. Same-material state repairs preserve their entity data. Placement-mode repairs retain excluded live properties. Diagnostic limit is 1-1000.

SIDE EFFECTS: writes selected block states with physics disabled and supported differing sign values only; optional snapshot creation. IMPORTANT: existing snapshots store block states only, not sign text/colors, inventory or arbitrary NBT. Entity replacement opt-in can destroy that data. All observed selected states/sign values are rechecked before the first snapshot/write. Late edits are skipped; there is no atomic lock or rollback guarantee. Correct cells and untouched cells are outside the repair write set. Reuse the returned comparisonId for further repairs, not the old one.
